text:
leila: Who's up for a sunrise surf (6:30) vs bookstore crawl (late morning) this weekend? trying to decide whether to be damp or cozy. :surfing_woman: :books:
dan: Surf if the swell's decent. If not, bookstore for the win + bad coffee.
taylor: I vote bookstore  coziness+hidden comic gem hunting. Anyone want to split rides?
quinn: Surf sounds great but I have a Saturday workshop. If bookstore crowd is doing a small meetup afterwards I'm in.
mike: Can someone check tide times? low at 6:45 looks ok. also surf + coffee afterwards = perfect.
leila: @mike tide check saved my life. https://tidal.example/forecast/today -> low @6:45, small NW swell.
dan: small swell = fun but beginner-friendly. bringing my spare board if anyone needs it.
taylor: I'll bring cash for used book piles and maybe donuts. who wants to carpool from Mission?
quinn: If bookstore wins, suggestion: start at Spine & Sparrow (11am), then cafe hop.
leila: quick poll: surf :ocean: 3 votes, bookstore :book: 2 votes (so far)
calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunrise Surf"  Saturday 6:30 AM  Meetup: Ocean Beach // Reminder 30m before
mike: if surf crew wants gear storage I can leave a bag at my place near the 24th St parking.
dan: awesome. if plans shift DM me. also optional towel+hot chocolate for after.
taylor: Whoever ends up at Spine & Sparrow, save me a bench spot. I will be late (long brunch). :slightly_smiling_face:
leila: Plan: surf crew meets 6:15 at the north lot; bookstore crew meets 11:00 at Spine & Sparrow. I'll post any updates by 5:30am Saturday.
quinn: Pico-optimist reminder: sunscreen even if overcast. :sun_with_face:
mike: meme: "I go surfing to avoid my inbox. It follows me." :joy:
